parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to reduce localized electric-field amplification at defects in a capacitor dielectric so breakdown does not initiate at the defect.
parsed.viable_reason: Assuming complete filling and adequate dielectric strength, the series-dielectric calculation is physically consistent and predicts a large local-field reduction with only a small bulk-field increase.
